name: KOReader (reading statistics, vocabulary builder, cover browser cache)
param_style: lua-ljsqlite3: numbers inlined with string.format("%d") in most statistics queries, ? binds elsewhere (here ?N)
schema_source: CREATE statements quoted from plugins/statistics.koplugin/main.lua, plugins/vocabbuilder.koplugin/db.lua and plugins/coverbrowser.koplugin/bookinfomanager.lua; main-schema stand-ins for the sync's attached income_db/cached_db
data_scale: scale 1: 400 books, 200k page_stat_data rows (8k evening sessions over 4 years; 8 re-read favourites with ~3.5k rows each; a third of the books partly read at another layout, so page_stat expands to ~207k rows), sync stand-ins with ~206k (income) and ~196k (cached) rows, 3k vocabulary words in 150 titles, 600 bookinfo rows; ~36 MB
visibility_note: 30.7k stars; the statistics plugin is enabled by default on Kobo, Kindle, PocketBook and Android installs
interest_note: Every statistics screen reads through the page_stat view, which rescales pages by joining page_stat_data to book and a numbers table with a computed range predicate; two-level GROUP BYs over strftime(localtime) keys, min(sum()) caps, a scalar subquery on an outer aggregate, row-value IN/NOT IN sync merges and an upsert of ~200k rows.
reach_note: millions of e-reader installs (Kobo, Kindle, PocketBook, Android); statistics are on by default and run on slow ARM CPUs

cpu_evidence.summary: Calendar view: each of its 2 SQL queries took ~500 ms on a Kobo (UI drawing ~20 ms); rewriting the month filter as integer bounds brought them to ~100 ms
Statistics 'Synchronise now' takes ~4-5 minutes on a Kobo Libra 2 with a 1.9 MB statistics.sqlite3 (network is not the bottleneck)
